script_text: Something big is shifting in your financial world this week, Taurus, and the stars won't be quiet. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun moves through your 5th House of creativity and romance, sparking bold self-expression while Mercury sharpens love communication. Wednesday brings a Full Moon in your 11th House of hopes and friendships — a culmination that transforms how you see your future. The key shift comes Wednesday when Venus trine Mars links your 4th House of home with the 12th House of hidden ambitions. Thursday forward, Jupiter trine Pluto activates your 2nd and 10th Houses — money and career aligning powerfully. The weekend settles into grounded earth energy. Thursday is your power day because Jupiter trine Pluto opens your financial gateway. Monday is caution day because the Sun in your 5th House scatters focus without intention. Invest boldly but write the numbers first. Follow for daily updates.
